next.settings.delegation.title: Agents delegating
next.settings.delegation.hint: An agent can hand a task to another agent in a new chat, shown under its own chat.
next.settings.delegation.anyChatHint: Otherwise an agent writes only to the chats it delegated.
next.settings.delegation.deliveryHint: When a working agent reads another agent's message: at its next step or after the turn. Questions arrive at once.
